verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Firstbase incorporates companies online. It has an 'incorporate-your-company' page, refers to 'companies that did not incorporate with Firstbase', offers a Carta cap table 'one click after incorporation', and a community user got a company 'up and running' in 2 weeks. Nothing confirms Delaware specifically, and bylaws and initial board approvals are never mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit Delaware C-corp filing documentation, bylaws generation, initial board consents/organizational resolutions, independent hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end flow.
